links.prerequisite: rho-strong: registered as rho.negation_strong (src/cryptanalysis/ecbench/methods.rs registry; ecbench::negation_strong), commit 6e04a8dec015faef6d923a68d59e271584756681. Second prerequisite, open: f2m4_torsion and gaudry_quartic_bin take m <= 15 (u16 F_q elements, 4m-bit packed points), so the decisive m = 16, 17 refuse at plan time until the tower is widened

question: On k=4 characteristic-two curves E/F_{2^{4m'}} (Gaudry D4, binary oracle), is index calculus below the strongest legitimate rho in counted F_q multiplications at m=16 and m=17, across the pricing band, with 8 fresh targets per arm?

claims.text: Every row recovers the planted discrete logarithm ([k]G = Q checked by the harness).
At m=16 and at m=17, summed counted cost of ic-wied over rho-strong has a 95% paired-bootstrap interval entirely below 1 at every weight w in {0, 0.1, 1} GAE per unpriced operation.
claims.if_supported: a measured crossover in a weak extension-field family, reported as such (no deployed curve)
claims.if_not_supported: the crossover is not established at m<=17; the red team's m*~17.6 (16.3-19.2) stands as a model value

claims.text: rho-neg reproduces the old records within the A/A spread (regression control).

hypotheses.statement: The IC/rho ratio crosses 1 between m=16 and m=17.
hypotheses.mechanism: The red team's corrected fit places the crossover at m*~17.6 (16.3-19.2); the measured gap closes as n^{-1/4}.

predictions.minimum_effect: interval upper end below 1 at m=17 at all three weights

data_seen.measured: m=15: 5.2x (2.4-15.0) after corrections, n=2 per arm; m=17: illustrative 0.43 from a killed run

provenance.decisive_scope: fresh targets at m=16,17; old targets excluded

arms.description: ic.pipeline + bin-t-line + gaudry-d4-bin (macaulay=11, frobenius=1, sparsest=1, replay=1, charge_unsolved=1: degenerate systems charged), plain Wiedemann

rho.negation_strong: negation-map rho, 32-jump additive walk, fruitless-cycle escape by doubling, distinguished points, 64 lanes per Montgomery-batched F_(q^4) inversion; every F_q multiplication counted, canonicalisation charged one F_q multiplication; GAE = F_q mults / fq_muls_per_add
the existing rho.negation, regression control against old records
rho.negation under a second arm name: the A/A noise floor

positive.not_applicable_reason: every row carries a planted logarithm checked by the harness; a miss is a wrong_answer row

negative.not_applicable_reason: a cost comparison between methods on the same targets asserts nothing about a null population

factors.name: targets
factors.value: 8 per m, fresh curve per target, seeds listed
factors.how: explicit seed list below; old targets W588..., W761..., d5f7..., W652... excluded

factors.name: pricing_weight
factors.how: every ratio computed at each weight (AGENTS.md section 5a)

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: interleaved within every round by the ecbench plan

seed_derivation.note: target seed = first 8 bytes (big-endian) of sha256(UTF-8 'gaudry-k4-redteam-v2|<m>|<i>'), m in 14..17, i in 0..7, listed in m-major order; the plan wrote '||' without an encoding, this record fixes it before any data; spec.json: one f2m4_torsion curve per listed seed (max_cofactor 16), one target each; target_seed 5767072793004074763 and measurement.seed 2122451695701588788 are the first 8 bytes of sha256('gaudry-k4-redteam-v2|target_seed') and sha256('gaudry-k4-redteam-v2|measurement_seed')

instance_sampling.rule: a fresh curve and target per seed from the existing constructor, independent of arm; all arms run on the same 8 targets per m

blinding.how: experiment_protocol.py blind writes a masked analysis copy; labels unmasked after the ratios are computed

power.note: 8 paired targets per decision m; with n=2 (the old data) no interval was possible. Two decisive tests (m=16, m=17), Holm-corrected

preflight_runtime.measured_on: plan estimate: about 30 h wall on 4 vCPUs; pilot up to 3.7 h and 7.6 h per IC target at m=16, 17

primary.name: counted F_q multiplications
primary.definition: every phase charged, setup included; rho with canonicalisation and batched inversion charged

primary.name: IC / rho-strong
primary.formula: sum_targets(total_gae[ic-wied] + w*unpriced[ic-wied]) / sum_targets(total_gae[rho-strong] + w*unpriced[rho-strong]) for w in {0,0.1,1}; total_gae = counted F_q mults / fq_muls_per_add on both arms
primary.definition: summed paired cost ratio per m and weight

secondary.name: CPU time per target
secondary.definition: solve interval on an L2 host

stopping_rules.rule: fixed design: 4 arms x 4 m x 8 targets, no warm-up round (an ecbench warm-up round repeats every workload and would double the 30 h; the counted primary metric does not depend on it); preflight ecbench verify --replay on one old clean session first
a killed or partial run is never recorded; *.attemptN-killed stays out of analysis

invalidation_rules: rows below L1 isolation are excluded from timing; counted units stand
a wrong_answer row is reported and excluded from the decisive ratio
rho-strong not built before freeze: the study does not start

the frozen instrument refuses m = 16, 17 (f2m4_torsion takes m <= 15); widening the tower is an instrument change, filed as an amendment with its commit before any m >= 16 row, and the m = 14, 15 arms are rerun on the widened binary only if its replay of this instrument's records differs

decision_rule.text: C2 supported at m when the Holm-corrected 95% paired-bootstrap interval of ic_over_rho lies below 1 at w=0, 0.1 and 1; 'trades' if the band straddles; 'loses' if above 1 at every w.
decision_rule.threshold: interval upper end < 1 at all three weights
decision_rule.interval: paired bootstrap over targets, 95%, Holm across m=16,17
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: ratio of summed F_q multiplications per weight

outputs: cargo run --release --example k4_replication_decide -- SESSION_DIR... (JSON: ratio, 95% paired-bootstrap interval and one-sided p per m and w, Holm over m = 16, 17, verdict per m, A/A and C3 controls)
ecbench compare --a rho-strong --b ic-wied per m and w

graphs: IC/rho by m with intervals at w=0,0.1,1

inadmissible: choosing the pricing unit after the data
reading a weak-family crossover as a statement about prime-order or deployed curves

literature.claim: corrected ratios and the frozen plan this record encodes
